hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 ETH/phiETH swap curve via beforeSwap: takes the full input amount from the PoolManager, deposits or withdraws through the phiEth contract, and settles the output — bypassing AMM concentrated liquidity via BeforeSwapDelta. Blocks direct liquidity additions and restricts pool initialization to ETH/phiETH pairs with zero fees.
